collections.name: Core
collections.description: The original 24 precision primitives: kinetic type, spatial cards, canvas networks, and developer-interface choreography.

collections.name: Studio Kit
collections.description: 24 hand-picked everyday motion patterns ported from Swirl Studio Kit: text reveals, feedback buttons, interactive cards, ambient backgrounds, loaders, and list interactions.

components.name: KineticType
components.description: Expressive kinetic typography engine where words and characters animate with coordinated rotation, scale, optical blur, and 3D position trajectories across four presets.
components.a11yNotes: Exposes the full unsplit sentence via aria-label on the semantic heading while marking animated glyph wrappers aria-hidden='true'. Renders static text immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
